Hi everyone!

Is it really that time already? With Part 7 of Contagious Augmentation, the last of my previously Patreon-exclusive comics is now freely accessible. This means that, as I always promised, my entire collection of work is now available for free.

As I already announced in my comment under the last part of Contagious Augmentation, I will unfortunately no longer be able to create new comics due to personal and professional reasons - so that's it from me - for now!

I still have an incredible amount of fun creating these comics. And reading your comments under my posts, seeing that you enjoy my work, fills me with so much joy. You are truly an amazing community, and I want to sincerely thank the creators of this site and, of course, all of you for the wonderful community we've created here!

That being said, without making any promises - because it really is up in the air - I wouldn't rule out coming back for a comic or two at some point in the future. But if I do, it will be completely without Patreon or anything like that, just right here where you all are anyway ^^

So, I really hope we aren't saying our goodbyes with a "farewell forever", but rather with a hopeful "see you later"!

Take care of yourselves and your loved ones - and all the best
